401909089.h: 76ers win opening game with LeBron James and Jaylen Brown, beating NBA champion Knicks 106-100
401909089.d: The Philadelphia 76ers sent an opening-night message they'll be a contender for the New York Knicks' NBA title after adding LeBron James and Jaylen Brown, rallying for a 106-100 victory Tuesday.

401909090.h: Gilgeous-Alexander, Thunder roll past Spurs 116-104 in first matchup since conference finals defeat
401909090.d: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had 32 points and the Oklahoma City Thunder opened their season with a 116-104 victory over the San Antonio Spurs, the team that ended their dreams of a title defense last season.

401909091.h: Anthony Edwards scores 45, Wolves roll past Heat 131-106 to spoil Giannis' opener
401909091.d: Anthony Edwards hit nine 3-pointers and scored 45 points to join an elite club, LaMelo Ball scored 21 in his Minnesota debut and the Timberwolves spoiled Giannis Antetokounmpo's first game with Miami by beating the Heat 131-106 on Wednesday night.

401909092.h: Walker Kessler has perfect Lakers debut with 12-for-12 shooting in 127-105 win over Warriors
401909092.d: Walker Kessler scored 26 points on 12-for-12 shooting and grabbed nine rebounds during his auspicious debut for the Los Angeles Lakers in a 127-105 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Wednesday night.

401909093.h: James, Embiid, Maxey spark 76ers' rally from 29 points down in home opener to stun Cavs 114-106
401909093.d: Tyrese Maxey scored 32 points and Joel Embiid had 24 to help LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers wipe out a 29-point deficit in their home opener and stun the Cleveland Cavaliers 114-106 on...

401909094.h: Thunder overcome SGA's shooting woes to beat Nuggets 96-84 in home opener
401909094.d: Jalen Williams scored 21 points, Chet Holmgren had 12 points and 17 rebounds, and the Oklahoma City Thunder withstood a poor shooting night from Shai-Gilgeous-Alexander in their home opener to beat the Denver Nuggets 96-84 on Thursday.

401909095.h: Jayson Tatum scores 36, sizzles down the stretch as Celtics fend off Knicks 107-103
401909095.d: Jayson Tatum scored 25 of his 36 points in the second half, including seven of his team’s final eight to help the Boston Celtics hold off the New York Knicks 107-103 on Friday night.

401909096.h: Amen Thompson blocks Wembanyama in final second as the Rockets beat the Spurs 114-110 in Austin
401909096.d: Amen Thompson blocked Victor Wembanyama's game-tying layup attempt with less than a second remaining and the Houston Rockets held on to beat the San Antonio Spurs 114-110 on Friday night.

401909834.h: Nickeil Alexander-Walker pours in 31, leads Hawks to season-opening 132-125 win over Magic
401909834.d: Nickeil Alexander-Walker punctuated a 31-point night with a pair of 3-pointers, Dyson Daniels and Jalen Johnson each finished with 20 points, and the Atlanta Hawks beat the Orlando Magic 132-125 in the season opener for both teams on Wednesday night.

401909835.h: Davis scores 34 points in his Washington debut, leading the Wizards over Milwaukee 128-116
401909835.d: Anthony Davis had 34 points and 12 rebounds in his debut with Washington, and the new-look Wizards beat the Milwaukee Bucks 128-116 on Wednesday night in the season opener for both teams.

401909836.h: Naz Reid has 20 points and 11 rebounds in his Charlotte debut as the Hornets beat the Nets 110-103
401909836.d: Naz Reid had 20 points and 11 rebounds in his Charlotte debut, Grayson Allen added 21 points off the bench and the Hornets beat the Brooklyn Nets 110-103 on Wednesday night.

401909837.h: Kawhi Leonard scores 23 points in Toronto return as Raptors rout Bulls 135-92
401909837.d: Kawhi Leonard scored 23 points in his return to Toronto, Scottie Barnes and Immanuel Quickley also had 23 apiece and the Raptors routed the Chicago Bulls 135-92 on Wednesday night in the season opener for both teams.

401909838.h: Ty Jerome' s career-high 45 points leads Grizzlies to a 123-103 victory over Jazz
401909838.d: Ty Jerome scored a career-high 45 points as the Memphis Grizzlies used a third-quarter rally enroute to a 123-103 victory over the Utah Jazz on Wednesday night in the season opener for both teams.

401909839.h: Siakam and Haliburton lead the Pacers past the Pelicans, 123-120
401909839.d: Pascal Siakam scored 30 points, including 12 in the final quarter, Tyrese Haliburton added 23 points and 12 assists in his first regular-season game since rupturing his right Achilles tendon 16 months ago and the Indiana Pacers beat the New Orleans...

401909840.h: Durant and Smith each score 30 points to power the Rockets past the Mavericks 128-110 in the opener
401909840.d: Kevin Durant and Jabari Smith Jr. scored 30 points apiece and the Houston Rockets used a big second quarter to build a huge lead and coast to a 128-110 win over the Dallas Mavericks on Wednesday night in the season opener for both teams.

401909841.h: Lillard returns with 25 points, Morant debuts and the Blazers rout the Suns 124-83
401909841.d: Damian Lillard scored 25 points in his first regular-season game since rejoining the Trail Blazers, leading Portland to a 124-83 season-opening rout of the Phoenix Suns on Wednesday night.

401909842.h: Kawhi-less Clippers roll past the Kings in a wire-to-wire season-opening rout
401909842.d: Darius Garland scored 30 points and the Clippers routed the Sacramento Kings 121-96 on Wednesday night in Los Angeles' first season opener without

401909843.h: Hornets blown out by Hawks 128-81 in first game home without LaMelo Ball, booed by sellout crowd
401909843.d: Jalen Johnson had 19 points, eight assists and seven rebounds and Atlanta hammered the Charlotte Hornets 128-81 on Friday night in the Hawks' largest blowout in franchise history.

401909844.h: Mavericks lose Flagg to injury, and ruin Haliburton's home return with 121-105 win over Pacers
401909844.d: Kyrie Irving scored 24 points and the Dallas Mavericks overcame the loss of Cooper Flagg to spoil Tyrese Haliburton 's home return for the Indiana Pacers in a 121-105 victory Friday...

401909845.h: Despite low output from Anthony Edwards, Timberwolves dominate glass and roll Magic 115-93
401909845.d: Anthony Edwards and Jaden McDaniels each scored 15 points to help the Minnesota Timberwolves beat the Orlando Magic 115-93 on Friday night.

401909846.h: Barnes, Barrett pace stingy Raptors to a 112-102 win over the Wizards
401909846.d: Scottie Barnes had 28 points and 14 rebounds, and the Toronto Raptors continued their stellar defensive start to the season with a 112-102 victory over the Washington Wizards on Friday night.

401909847.h: Pistons roll past Heat 128-111, adding to Miami's season-opening woes on defensive end
401909847.d: John Collins scored 23 points, Paul Reed added 19 off the bench and the Detroit Pistons added to Miami's season-opening defensive misery by beating the Heat 128-111 on Friday night.

401909848.h: Powell scores 25 points to help the Bulls hold off the Bucks, 132-125
401909848.d: Norman Powell had 25 points, rookie Caleb Wilson added 21 and the Chicago Bulls beat the Milwaukee Bucks 132-125 on Friday.

401909849.h: Jackson scores 24 and Peterson makes go-ahead FTs to lift Jazz over Pelicans
401909849.d: Jaren Jackson Jr. had 24 points and 10 rebounds, rookie Darryn Peterson made the go-ahead free throws with 50.5 second left, and the Utah Jazz outlasted the New Orleans Pelicans 120-119 on Friday night.

401909850.h: Cameron Boozer hits go-ahead jumper with 20 seconds left, Grizzlies rally to beat Warriors 111-108
401909850.d: Cameron Boozer made a go-ahead jumper with 20 seconds left and finished with 25 points and 13 rebounds, and the Memphis Grizzlies came from 12 points down over the final 3:47 to beat the Golden State Warriors 111-108 on Friday night.

401909851.h: Austin Reaves, Walker Kessler lead Lakers past Clippers 125-117 for 2nd win to start season
401909851.d: Austin Reaves had 28 points and nine assists, Walker Kessler added 22 points and six blocked shots, and the Los Angeles Lakers beat the Los Angeles Clippers 125-117 on Friday night for their second win to start the season.

401909852.h: Deni Avdija scores 26 points to lead Trail Blazers in win over Kings
401909852.d: Deni Avdija led the Trail Blazers with 26 points, six rebounds, and six assists in the Portland Trail Blazers 128-120 victory over the Sacramento Kings on Friday.

401909853.h: Brandon Miller scores 34 points as the Hornets beat the winless Heat 115-110
401909853.d: Brandon Miller scored 34 points and the Charlotte Hornets beat the winless Miami Heat 115-110 on Saturday, bouncing back from one of the worst losses in franchise history a night earlier.

401909854.h: Cavaliers survive a late Nets rally to win home opener 125-121
401909854.d: Donovan Mitchell scored 22 points, Jarrett Allen added 21 points, and the Cleveland Cavaliers won their home opener, 125-121 over the Brooklyn Nets on Saturday night.

401909855.h: Embiid posts triple-double with LeBron out to keep 76ers perfect in 127-116 win over Bucks
401909855.d: Joel Embiid had a triple-double with LeBron James out, Jaylen Brown scored 27 points on his 30th birthday and the Philadelphia 76ers remained undefeated with a 127-116 win over the Milwaukee Bucks on Saturday night.

401909856.h: Durant scores 22, Sheppard hits five 3-pointers to lead Rockets to a win in Atlanta's home opener
401909856.d: Kevin Durant scored 22 points and both Reed Sheppard and Tari Eason had 19 points as the Houston Rockets beat the Atlanta Hawks 121-114.

401909857.h: Young scores 25 points as the Wizards hold off Wilson and the Bulls for a 124-120 win
401909857.d: Trae Young had 25 points and nine assists, and the Washington Wizards held off the Chicago Bulls for a 124-120 victory on Saturday night.

401909858.h: Wembanyama, Harper lead Spurs past short-handed Mavericks 122-106 for their first victory
401909858.d: Victor Wembanyama had 23 points, seven rebounds and four blocks, Dylan Harper scored 22 points and the San Antonio Spurs beat the Dallas Mavericks 122-106 on Saturday night for their first victory of the season.

401909859.h: Jokic has triple-double, Murray scores 42 points in Nuggets' OT victory over Pelicans
401909859.d: Nikola Jokic scored eight of his 35 points in overtime and finished with 15 rebounds and 10 assists, and the short-handed Denver Nuggets rallied from down 23 to beat the New Orleans Pelicans 141-135 on Saturday night.

401909860.h: Booker scores 43 points in Suns' 131-122 win over Warriors, who fall to 0-3
401909860.d: Devin Booker scored 43 points, Miles Bridges added 16 and the Phoenix Suns won their home opener for the fifth straight season by beating the short-handed Golden State Warriors 131-122 on Saturday night.

401909861.h: Luka Doncic scores NBA season-high 52 points in the Lakers' victory over the Jazz
401909861.d: Luka Doncic scored 52 points, hitting eight 3-pointers, to lead the Los Angeles Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday.

401909862.h: Haliburton has 24 points and 10 assists as the Pacers beat the winless Nets 136-109
401909862.d: Tyrese Haliburton had 24 points, 10 assists and an All-Star Game-worthy dunk as the Indiana Pacers hammered the Brooklyn Nets 136-109 on Sunday night.

401909863.h: Wagner, Magic use big fourth quarter to drop Knicks to 0-3 with 111-102 victory
401909863.d: Franz Wagner scored 21 of his 23 points in the fourth quarter, and the Orlando Magic dropped the reigning champion New York Knicks to 0-3 with a 111-102 win Sunday night.

401909864.h: Timberwolves stay unbeaten with 117-94 win over Raptors in home opener
401909864.d: Anthony Edwards scored 26 points in 27 minutes to lead a hot-shooting home opener for the Minnesota Timberwolves in a 117-94 victory Sunday over a Toronto Raptors team

401909865.h: Thunder stay undefeated with a 108-101 victory over the Clippers
401909865.d: Shai-Gilgeous Alexander scored 34 points, Ajay Mitchell had 18 off the bench and the Oklahoma City Thunder stayed undefeated with a 108-101 victory over the Los Angeles Clippers on Sunday night.

401909866.h: Cunningham scores 26, Collins has double-double in Detroit's 106-93 win over LeBron, 76ers
401909866.d: Cade Cunningham scored 26 points, and John Collins had 16 points and 11 rebounds to help the Detroit Pistons stay unbeaten with a 106-93 win over LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers on Sunday night.

401909867.d: Ty Jerome had 31 points, making all 14 of his free throw attempts, to lead the Memphis Grizzlies to a 123-112 win over the Sacramento Kings on Sunday night.

news.d: — Tyrese Haliburton had 24 points, 10 assists and an All-Star Game-worthy dunk as the Indiana Pacers hammered the Brooklyn Nets 136-109 on Sunday night.

news.h: Lakers' Luka Doncic scores NBA season-high 52 points with 10 assists in win
news.d: Luka Doncic scored 52 points, hitting eight 3-pointers, to lead the Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Jazz on Sunday. It was the first 50-point game this season in the NBA.

news.h: Luka Doncic scores NBA season-high 52 points in the Lakers' victory over the Jazz
news.d: — Luka Doncic scored 52 points, hitting eight 3-pointers, to lead the Los Angeles Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday.

news.h: Raptors fall to Wolves with Kawhi Leonard out due to knee swelling
news.d: Raptors star Kawhi Leonard is out for Sunday night's game against the Timberwolves due to left knee swelling.

news.h: Sixers overrule Embiid, sit center with plantar fasciitis management
news.d: Despite publicly calling to play Sunday against the Pistons, the 76ers decided to sit Joel Embiid due to right foot plantar fasciitis management.

news.h: Pistons C Jalen Duren out at least two weeks with hamstring strain
news.d: Pistons center Jalen Duren, who signed a five-year extension earlier this month, will be out at least two weeks with a right hamstring strain.

news.h: Booker scores 43 points in Suns' 131-122 win over Warriors, who fall to 0-3
news.d: — Devin Booker scored 43 points, Miles Bridges added 16 and the Phoenix Suns won their home opener for the fifth straight season by beating the short-handed Golden State Warriors 131-122 on Saturday night.
